content: In Melvin-Koushki's paraphrase, Ibn Turka says Jazarī's enmity began when, in Egypt, the Mamluk sultan asked Ibn Turka about Jazarī and Ibn Turka sketched his character and qualifications, lowering Jazarī in that ruler's estimation; Jazarī could not name this reason in Fars without endangering his position and so caused trouble by other means, though Ibn Turka says he showed him only respect.
refers_to_primary: Ibn Turka, Nafsat al-Maṣdūr II, pp.211-12 (per MK fn.109)
